verdict.rationale: A downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask for a SaaS code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Bitbucket publishes one: probes of candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths on support.atlassian.com all returned 404. The generic 'build custom integrations' claim is an adjacent statement and does not document a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
